securityAlertSummary: 3 new medium alerts; not zero security findings

alerts.rule: File data in outbound network request
alerts.evidence: Manual opt-in Node installer reads checked-in runtime/model.json; public Google model URL and SHA fixed in reviewed source16, redirect:error,30s timeout,maxBytes10000000. Manifest is repository-owner configuration, not caller/request data.
alerts.proposedScopedDisposition: Intentional model artifact download under trusted local repository/model-directory ownership; no automatic network operation in the application. No code change proposed pending independent Root review.

alerts.evidence: Bytes are size bounded and SHA256 checked against fixed repository manifest before writing constant local runtime/models/hand_landmarker.task.download and renaming to constant target. Network bytes do not choose paths or execute.
alerts.proposedScopedDisposition: Intentional integrity-verified artifact file write with trusted local model directory; no code change proposed pending independent Root review.

alerts.rule: Missing origin verification in postMessage handler
alerts.evidence: demo.mjs creates a dedicated Worker from self URL. CameraSession owns its handle; worker uses implicit dedicated message port, not Window cross-document postMessage or SharedWorker/ServiceWorker. Local HTML/server CSP worker-src/connect-src self, frame-ancestors none on served response. No transferred message ports accepted and output is VIEW_ONLY/no authority.
alerts.proposedScopedDisposition: Dedicated creator/implicit-port context; Window-origin check finding appears inapplicable. Independent Root source-context confirmation required.

assumptions: Trusted checkout/manifest and owner-controlled local model directory; hostile same-user repository/code edits are outside this prototype boundary
Prototype remains loopback and VIEW_ONLY; no production host, financial/physical execution or actual-camera accuracy acceptance
next: Root independently reviews these actual source boundaries and determines any mustfix; original source16 stays pinned unless a reviewed source revision is necessary
